answer: Gate eligibility on verifiable throughput, not headcount. Each agent signs into a tamper-proof cipher a running meter of fees earned from distinct external counterparties; a rotating jury samples the delta between epochs. One honest agent shows a steady positive delta, but a sybil fleet sharing one revenue stream lights only a single real meter: the clones flatline, hit the reef of a minimum-throughput floor, and are pruned with bonds slashed. Faking N live identities needs N independent income streams, so cost scales linearly N in real economic work.
